body:
lib/worktrees.mjs ensureGitignore currently writes only ['.worktrees/', '.booster/', '.adlc/*', '!.adlc/tickets.json'] into a target repo's .gitignore. The canonical ADLC stanza (written by adlc ticket store migrate and prescribed by the adlc-antigravity plugin's adlc-init) additionally negates the directory ticket store and specs: '!.adlc/tickets/', '!.adlc/tickets/**', '!.adlc/ticket-archive/', '!.adlc/ticket-archive/**', '!.adlc/specs/', and keeps '!.adlc/config.json'. Without these, a booster-bootstrapped target repo gitignores its own ticket shards and specs.

Update the missing-lines set in ensureGitignore to the full canonical stanza (append-only: only add lines that are absent, preserve existing content, same as current behavior).

Acceptance criteria:
- Unit test asserts a fresh repo gets the full stanza and an already-complete .gitignore is left byte-identical.
- Unit test asserts a partial stanza (e.g. legacy-only lines) gains exactly the missing negations.
- npm test green.
title: fix: align worktree gitignore stanza with the canonical ADLC store layout
